title: Admission Officer
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking dynamic and student-focused professionals to join our Admissions team. As an Admission Officer, you will be the first point of contact for prospective students and play a vital role in guiding them toward the right academic and career choices. This role requires strong communication, empathy, and a results-driven mindset to ensure an exceptional student experience while achieving admission targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Career Guidance & Counselling**

● Engage with prospective students and their families to understand aspirations and

recommend suitable academic programs.

● Provide clear, comprehensive information that builds trust and inspires interest in our

offerings.

**Student Lifecycle Management & Admissions**

● Manage the complete student journey: prospecting, counseling, admission, orientation,

and ongoing support.

● Drive conversions by achieving and exceeding weekly and monthly admission targets.

● Oversee fee structures and ensure accurate management of the fee software for various

programs.

**Compliance & Internal Processes**

● Adhere to institutional policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.

● Maintain accurate records of student interactions and admissions activities.

**Effective Communication & Engagement**

● Build strong relationships through timely follow-ups, both online and offline.

● Handle inbound/outbound calls and walk-in inquiries with professionalism to maximize

conversion rates.

**Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline.

● Strong interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

● Empathy, patience, and the ability to connect with students from diverse backgrounds.

● Problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently.

● Prior experience in student counseling, academic advisory, or admissions will be an

advantage.

● Proficiency in MS Office and basic computer applications.

● Energetic, motivated, and proactive with a results-oriented attitude.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹39,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Calicut, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Front Office Executive
description:
Front Office Executive

**Location:** Ernakulam  
**Industry:** EdTech  
**Job Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are hiring a **Front Office Executive** for our EdTech company in Kozhikode. The candidate will be responsible for managing front desk activities, handling student and parent inquiries, coordinating admissions support, and ensuring a professional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage front desk operations and welcome visitors
* Handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages, and walk-in inquiries
* Provide course and admission information to students and parents
* Coordinate appointments, follow-ups, and daily office activities
* Maintain inquiry records, student data, and office documents
* Support the admissions and operations team
* Ensure a clean and professional reception area

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, Email, Excel)
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities
* Professional attitude and customer service mindset

Eligibility

* Any Graduate / Diploma
* Freshers and experienced candidates can apply

KPIs / Performance Metrics

* Inquiry response time
* Student follow-up completion rate
* Accuracy of records and data entry
* Visitor/student satisfaction
* Punctuality and attendance
* Support in inquiry-to-admission conversions

Preferred Candidate

* Friendly and confident personality
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
* Prior front office or customer support experience is an advantage

Pay: From ₹17,200.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
